changes.old: On 2 November 2026, Zoetis made a remedy offer to the ACCC that it would provide a court-enforceable undertaking pursuant to s87B of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (the Act), which would require Zoetis to divest and/or make available the assets (excluding Zoetis’ laboratory located in the United States) associated with its supply of bovine genomics testing services to beef breed societies and their members in Australia to New Zealand Institute for Bioeconomy Science Limited trading as Bioeconomy Science Institute (GenomNZ) or such other purchaser approved by the ACCC (the remedy offer). The ACCC invites you to provide submissions or information in response to the questions below by 5:00PM AEDT on 11 November 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with a copy to mergersru@accc.gov.au, with the title Submission re Zoetis – Neogen Genomics Business – Remedy Offer. The ACCC must complete its assessment within strict statutory timelines which also impacts the time available for consultation. The ACCC's ability to give detailed consideration to submissions received after this time may be limited. Open date 4 Nov 2026 Closing date 11 Nov 2026
